name: Khost

queries.query: Khost Afghanistan cadastral map parcel registry official; Afghanistan cadastral land registry GIS map official Khost
queries.result: First-party discovery found Afghanistan's Ministry of Justice Property Registration Management Information System (PRMIS/PMS), the Ministry of Urban Development and Land report on state-land surveying and registration in Khost, and the national Khost province information page. No public Khost parcel-vector viewer or anonymous parcel API was exposed. The Ministry of Justice PMS returned an Afghanistan-only access notice from this environment.

queries.query: د خوست کادستر نقشه ځمکې رسمي; کادستر خوست افغانستان نقشه ثبت املاک
queries.result: د رسمي سرچینو په موندنه کې د عدلیې وزارت د معاملو د لارښونې سیستم (PRMIS/PMS)، د خوست د دولتي ځمکو د سروې او ثبت رسمي راپور، او د خوست ولایتي معلومات وموندل شول. د خوست د پارسلونو لپاره عامه خوندي ID+geometry خدمت ونه موندل شو؛ PMS له دې چاپېریال څخه د افغانستان دننه لاسرسي پیغام وښود.

registryEvidence.custodian: No Khost local registry/cadastre custodian with a public parcel service was evidenced. National Ministry of Justice and land-survey agencies were found, but national agency prose and a provincial state-land registration report do not establish a city-local public parcel source.
registryEvidence.scope: The official MUDL report says 178,188 jeribs of state-owned land and public properties were surveyed and registered in Khost province; it does not publish parcel polygons, safe parcel IDs, or a public query service.

parcelDiscovery.source: No qualified public Khost cadastral parcel source.

attemptedRoutes.outcome: HTTP 200 official Ministry of Justice application shell. The page identifies PRMIS/PMS as a property-registration management system but displayed an access restriction stating the program is usable only from Afghanistan. No anonymous parcel endpoint was exposed in the retrieved shell.

HTTP 200 current JavaScript inspected. It confirms a same-origin /api backend and application routes, but no anonymous cadastral parcel route was identified; no login or credentialed request was attempted.
Official MUDL report found. It documents province-level state-land surveying and registration in Khost, but provides no public parcel schema, native parcel ID, CRS, geometry response, or map/API URL.

HTTP 200 anonymous ArcGIS response inspected as a cross-check. The layer is named Khost_Boundary, is a single boundary polygon layer in EPSG:3857, and exposes FID as its system-maintained object ID; it is not a cadastral parcel layer and was not retained as a parcel sample.
Official national portal page confirms Khost provincial information and offices, but does not expose a cadastral parcel map or public parcel API.

parcelDiscovery.note: The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted or used as an absence test. No exact-point parcel query was issued because no qualified public parcel endpoint was exposed. An access restriction, map-layer mismatch, or lack of an exposed API is not evidence of citywide absence.

uncertainty: No local Khost cadastral custodian or public parcel-vector service was evidenced in this attempt.
The official Khost report concerns surveyed state/public land at province scale and does not provide queryable parcel geometry or safe native parcel IDs.
The ArcGIS Khost_Boundary response is an administrative boundary, not parcel evidence; no GeoJSON sample was written.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, certificate, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is not source integration or runtime admission.
